turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.

Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. You pay the return postage, and staff must approve the refund. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email used for the order so I can check whether a return can be requested.
